v10_verdict: SHIP as recorded (change 10/12, deliberately-broken 3/12). Re-extracting all 72 stage-graph v10 transcripts with the amended extractor gives byte-identical observations (0 differences), so the v10 verdict is unchanged. v9 and earlier stay as recorded.
reason: instrument defect found by diagnosing v9: lib/stage-graph-cell.js discarded a classify whenever the Bash call holding it had is_error:true, although a call is_error says only that SOME segment failed. In `classify; stage-advance --to X` a refused advance made the whole call is_error and hid the classify that had succeeded and printed its probe object.

defect.example: `node scripts/probe-unknown.js classify --work-unit retry; node scripts/stage-advance.js --to finish` with the advance refused: the call is_error, the result holds the classify's {eligible_max:...} object followed by the refused advance's {allowed:false,...}. The old rule (`!refused`) recorded classify_called=false and rung `none`, which fails a brief whose key needs the classify.

checked_same_family.stage_advance: already judged per invocation from its own JSON (amend-2/3); the call-level is_error is not used for it
checked_same_family.session_mode_set: already judged per invocation from its own {ok:true} object; the is_error fallback applies only when the JSON cannot be attributed

change: A classify counts when its call was not refused (unchanged), or when the refused call's own result holds a full probe object: artifact_type unknown_probe plus the fields only probe-unknown.js emits next to eligible_max (recommend, signals, budget). Nothing else moved: the first classify still wins, the rung is read from that object, at_intent still uses amend-5's source-position rule.
attribution_rule: The refusal is attributed to the classify only when a full probe object is visible. A bare {"eligible_max":..} printed by another segment of the call (or a cut-off object) proves nothing, so it does not count. A refused call without a full probe object stays discarded exactly as before: conservative. The premise that only probe-unknown.js prints that shape is asserted by hooks/tests/skill-onoff-stage-graph.test.sh (no other script under scripts/ mentions eligible_max).

rescore.method: every results/stage-graph-cells/stage-graph.v10/stage-graph-*/<arm>/<rep>/transcript.jsonl read by the pre-amendment extractor (b00fb434) and the amended one, observed objects compared field for field; also compared against the retained stage-graph-extracted.json of each cell

other_rows: stage-graph-g67 and stage-graph-g8 use lib/g67-cell.js and lib/g8-cell.js, which have no classify extraction and do not import stage-graph-cell.js; their scorers were re-run and their verdicts are unchanged.
text_unchanged: guidance text, packs, arms, briefs, answer keys, markers, base arm and thresholds are unchanged.
comparability: applies to cells run from v11 on. v10 rows stay as recorded and are not re-written.
unchanged: base arm and base pack ids
